packageRules.description: Commit type per CLAUDE.md: dependencies are build changes.
GitHub Actions updates change the CI.
Minor, patch and digest updates arrive together in one weekly PR; majors stay separate.
The logback appender must match the OpenTelemetry version Spring Boot manages; it is updated by hand together with Spring Boot (libs.versions.toml).
Postgres stays on Neon's major version (ADR-0008); that upgrade is done on purpose.
npm 12 fails Renovate's lockfile step on packages with bundleDependencies such as Tailwind's oxide (npm/cli#9800), the reason for the ^11 constraint. Remove this rule once a released npm 12 fixes it.
typescript-eslint does not support TypeScript 7 yet: its peer range ends below 6.1 (typescript-eslint#10940). Remove this rule once a release accepts TypeScript 7.
